summary: Report fresh roster wait exits and verify unchanged cards on the served publication

schema.detail: No table, index, trigger, claim, storage version or public response shape change.

rules.detail: Existing wait target, two-second deadline, refresh-failure fallback, notification, admission, pacing, cache and publisher mutation behavior remain. The original unchanged-through predicate is byte-identical. A new read-only predicate checks the actual served complete publication identity and original expiry/local/fault/delta guards for telemetry only.

compatibility.detail: Adds bounded attributes to an existing request span; no response fields change. Adds bounded request-span fresh-wait outcome/target and exact-served unchanged-proof attributes. The OTEL assertion retains numeric freshness or requires the explicit verified exception; actual card-affecting claim cuts remain a strict lower bound. Wait failure, disconnection and timeout are distinct and cannot supply unchanged verification.

downtime.detail: No performance gain asserted by source. Only a recording traced unchanged fresh response adds one read-only snapshot/range proof; plain and untraced reads do not run this extra proof. No card fold or writer operation is added. The interval proof cost and real hosted outcomes remain unqualified.

recovery.detail: Source rollback removes additive telemetry/controls without migration. Historical first failures and missing unseen author-fixture parity stay disclosed.
